# Test fixtures

## `irrigation_handbook.pdf`

- Generated by `make_fixture_pdf.py` (ReportLab). The text was written for this project and contains no third-party
  content. Structure: three chapters, parents with introductory text, a leaf that spans two pages, running headers and
  page numbers on every page. Regenerate with `uv run python tests/fixtures/make_fixture_pdf.py`.
- Its bookmark titles carry the book's own numbers, which the structure analysis checks.

## `author_queries.jsonl`

- 39 answerable queries (13 leaves x direct, paraphrase, contextual) and 4 out-of-scope queries (`gold_section: null`).
- Written by the project's engineering agent after the fixture text and before any model was run. Not an independent
  annotation: the author of the queries also wrote the fixture.
- Gold answers are section numbers, mapped to canonical leaf ids through `toc.json` at evaluation time. Out-of-scope
  queries are reported separately and never enter ranking metrics.
- Use with `tocleaf eval-bm25 --queries` and `tocleaf eval-stair --queries`.

Neither file is evidence about any real document. The results they produce are fixture-level smoke tests.
